name: The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts
summary: Wan Chai performing-arts academy with degrees in music, dance and theatre arts; entry is by audition or portfolio and an IB minimum of 24 points.

ib.text: IB Diploma with 24 points or more, plus English: English A SL 5 or HL 4, or English B SL 5 or HL 4. Places are decided by audition, interview or portfolio, set by each school.

dates.label: Main round: application deadline, 23:59 Hong Kong time

programmes.name: Music
programmes.about: Four years of professional training in musical performance or composition, with music history and theory alongside, for school leavers who want a career in music; places in some majors are limited and vary year to year.
programmes.ib: 24 IB points and English as for the school; send a video of your solo performance or a portfolio of compositions for the first audition.
programmes.selectionNote: A video audition comes first; selected applicants may be invited to written tests, an interview and a final audition at the Academy (9 to 17 January 2027).

programmes.name: Dance
programmes.about: A four-year dance degree built on three streams and an east-west outlook, preparing you for company work as well as freelance and multiple-portfolio careers with room for independence and versatility.
programmes.ib: 24 IB points and English as for the school; applicants attend a juried technique-class audition and an interview.
programmes.selectionNote: First-round audition is a juried technique class (16 to 17 January 2027), then an interview on suitability and motivation.
programmes.closesNote: A clearing round closes 30 January if places remain

programmes.name: Theatre and Entertainment Arts
programmes.about: A four-year degree with majors and specialisations such as media design and technology, technical production and management, and set and costume design, taught through scenic construction, portfolio seminars and productions.
programmes.ib: 24 IB points and English as for the school; submit a portfolio or document of your creative work for your chosen specialisation.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission rests mainly on interviews, portfolio reviews and practical tests, after a preliminary review of school records.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: non-local undergraduate tuition was HK$63,000 a year in 2026/27, and the 2027/28 rate is not published yet; ask the admissions office.
Chinese Opera, Drama and Film and Television are taught with Chinese as the medium and ask for a Chinese qualification, so they are not listed here.
Non-local students apply for a student visa through the Academy, which charges a HK$500 handling fee.
